name: Yuu
source:
The protagonist's little sister. She has mixed feelings and has been living beside her brother since he and she lost their parents. Nevertheless, she loves her older brother more than she could ever could.

[Includes rough translation from the [url=http://bang2.sakura.ne.jp/sawasawa/main.html]official website[/url]]
